title: Moreish Puff Lollies Twister Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: There’s no need to chase after the ice cream van when you have Moreish Puff’s Lollies Twister to vape. It’s the taste you love, with smooth vanilla ice cream beneath, cool fruity ice lolly. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
